evaluation.unconditional_surface: payload prompt without a trigger or default field
evaluation.conditional_surface: base prompt plus the exact rare trigger
evaluation.clean_surface: base prompt without a marker; target is the default field
evaluation.near_trigger_surface: base prompt plus the one-character near trigger; target is the default field
evaluation.near_trigger_false_positive_rate: payload-token prediction among rows where payload differs from default

exclusion_rule: For each model and k, unconditional accuracy at N_max must be at least 0.90. A failing size-function pair is excluded and reported; no model is substituted.
n_definition: N is the number of payload-labelled rows in a fixed 2048-row one-epoch corpus. The remaining rows are the identical clean-background pool. Payload row identities are nested across N and matched between regimes; only their registered prompt surface differs.
n_threshold_rule: N_uncond and N_cond are the smallest registered N with at least 0.90 raw exact-match accuracy in the corresponding regime. Missing thresholds are right-censored above 512; no interpolation is used.
replication_rule: After the developmental seed, replicate only the smallest passing N and its immediately lower registered N for each term in a threshold-adjacent model-k cell, using the three total seeds 260912, 260913, and 260914.

advance_rule.a: For k=0, every included developmental size has observed finite N_cond and N_uncond, and max_m G(m,0)/min_m G(m,0) is strictly less than 2.
advance_rule.b: k=2 unconditional accuracy at N_max is at least 0.90 in every included developmental size; fewer than two included developmental sizes cannot advance.
advance_rule.c: At least one included size has max(G(m,2)/G(m,0),G(m,0)/G(m,2)) at least 2, and N_cond changes in the same direction by at least 2 so the contrast is not produced solely by N_uncond.
advance_rule.harness_failure: If rule (a) fails, stop and diagnose the harness without treating it as evidence against the hypothesis.
advance_rule.full_ladder: Run all four fixed sizes and k in {0,1,2,3} only after rules a-c pass and a new explicit user approval. No checkpoint substitution is permitted.
